reference_sql:
SELECT CAST(date_trunc('quarter', e.event_date) AS DATE) AS quarter_start,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_type IN ('new', 'expansion', 'reactivation') THEN e.mrr_delta_local * f.eur_per_unit ELSE 0 END)
    / NULLIF(-SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_type IN ('contraction', 'churn') THEN e.mrr_delta_local * f.eur_per_unit ELSE 0 END), 0), 2) AS quick_ratio
FROM subscription_events e
JOIN subscriptions s ON s.subscription_id = e.subscription_id
JOIN fx_rates f ON f.currency = s.currency AND f.rate_date = DATE '2025-12-31'
WHERE e.event_type <> 'opening'
  AND e.event_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY CAST(date_trunc('quarter', e.event_date) AS DATE)

    -SUM(e.mrr_delta_local * f.eur_per_unit) FILTER (WHERE e.event_type IN ('contraction', 'churn')) AS lost
  FROM subscription_events e
  JOIN subscriptions s ON s.subscription_id = e.subscription_id
  JOIN fx_rates f ON f.currency = s.currency AND f.rate_date = DATE '2025-12-31'
  WHERE e.event_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY CAST(date_trunc('quarter', e.event_date) AS DATE)
)
SELECT quarter_start, ROUND(gained / NULLIF(lost, 0), 2) AS quick_ratio
FROM q

solver.query:
WITH ev AS (SELECT e.account_id, a.segment, e.event_type, e.event_date, s.currency, e.mrr_delta_local AS d, e.mrr_delta_local * f.eur_per_unit AS eur
  FROM subscription_events e JOIN subscriptions s ON s.subscription_id = e.subscription_id JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = e.account_id
  JOIN fx_rates f ON f.currency = s.currency AND f.rate_date = DATE '2025-12-31'), m AS (SELECT CAST(t.d AS DATE) AS ms, CAST(t.d + INTERVAL '3 months' AS DATE) AS nx FROM generate_series(DATE '2025-01-01', DATE '2025-10-01', INTERVAL '3 months') AS t(d))
SELECT m.ms AS quarter_start, ROUND(SUM(ev.eur) FILTER (WHERE ev.event_type IN ('new', 'expansion', 'reactivation')) / NULLIF(-SUM(ev.eur) FILTER (WHERE ev.event_type IN ('contraction', 'churn')), 0), 2) AS quick_ratio
FROM m LEFT JOIN ev ON ev.event_date >= m.ms AND ev.event_date < m.nx AND ev.event_type <> 'opening' GROUP BY m.ms
